notes: Tunables for tools/sweep/sweep.py (the SWEEP THE REPO BEFORE BUILDING guard). exempt_globs: paths that never need a Sweep: trailer (docs, tests, data) -- fnmatch, where * also crosses '/'. generic_*: names too common to compare by similarity (an exact same-path hit is still reported). similarity is a difflib ratio on lower-cased, separator-free names; token_overlap is a Jaccard over CamelCase/snake tokens and only counts with 2+ shared tokens. Raise either to cut noise, lower to catch more. budget_s is the hard wall-clock cap for one sweep (every git call shares it; worktrees still unscanned when it runs out are reported as not searched (budget), never a refusal); budget_reserve_s of it is kept back for scoring. The hook shell adds an outer kill at budget_s + 4 s for a hung interpreter; the SWEEP_SKIP path adds at most 3 x skip_git_timeout_s after the budget, so keep that under 4 s.
